outcome_evidence: The oven door is closed at frame 0 in image and left_ego_image. The robot approaches the handle, and frames 101–118 in image and left_ego_image show the door progressively opening downward, exposing the interior rack and green dish. At frames 130–140, the door remains open as the gripper withdraws; wrist_image also shows the open door beside the gripper. No failed acquisition, unwanted object displacement, or other side effect is visibly established.
